title: Mise
subtitle: Interactive recipe discovery and 3D cooking studio
description: Explore recipes from around the world and practise cooking in an interactive 3D kitchen. Mise combines step-by-step guidance, optional physics, Cook Mode, prep checklists, persistent timers, shopping lists and a device-local personal cookbook with backup and restore.
features: Touch-friendly virtual kitchen with optional 3D physics and accessible controls
Focused Cook Mode, preparation checklists and multiple persistent timers
Offline-capable PWA, shopping lists and reviewed cookbook import/backup

title: Tally

Guided practice and adaptive spaced review
Offline-capable PWA with local progress and optional encrypted sync
